source.inventory: Grove SampleType all-known quantities, categories, correlations, other sample types, clinical records, ECG, workout, and explicit sleep aggregate
source.sdkBaseline: Apple HealthKit source surface captured at the exact Grove repository revision below

sourceTypeCoding.rule: Every admitted HealthKit Observation preserves its exact sourceTypeIdentifier as an additional provider coding; the shared or authoritative standard coding remains the normative result meaning.

statusVocabulary.supported: The 0.2.0 HealthKit adapter defines and validates emitted FHIR output.
statusVocabulary.mapped-standard: The source is represented by another exact Grove or authoritative standard package rather than a Mobile measurement profile.
statusVocabulary.provider-specific: The 0.2.0 adapter defines output whose meaning remains HealthKit-specific.
statusVocabulary.deferred: No FHIR output for this source type is admitted by the 0.2.0 adapter.
statusVocabulary.intentionally-unsupported: The 0.2.0 contract explicitly rejects this source meaning rather than approximating it.

body-mass-index.reason: FHIR R4 already publishes an authoritative BMI profile; a one-source Grove Mobile wrapper would duplicate it.

callerEvidence: all HKElectrocardiogram.VoltageMeasurement values and timeSinceSampleStart offsets
the exact associated HKCategorySample objects when symptomsStatus is present

children.meaning: Exact HKCategorySample UUID under the HealthKit object NamingSystem
Exact admitted HealthKit symptom category identifier

sourceRevisionDisclosure.failureRule: Without explicit caller authorization to disclose every correlated symptom HKSourceRevision field, the structured HealthKit ECG output is not admitted and conversion fails closed.
sourceRevisionDisclosure.scope: Authorization is producer input and is not encoded as a FHIR consent or authorization assertion.

electrocardiogram.effectiveRule: Observation.effectivePeriod starts at HKElectrocardiogram.startDate plus the exact first timeSinceSampleStart and ends at the exact last supplied voltage instant. The required healthkit-ecg-source-period extension separately preserves the HKElectrocardiogram startDate/endDate.
electrocardiogram.admissionRule: The caller supplies already-obtained evidence. The supplied voltage count equals numberOfVoltageMeasurements; offsets are complete, unique, sorted, and satisfy offset[i] = offset[0] + i * SampledData.period exactly; every voltage is present; and samplingFrequency, when reported, equals 1000 / period in milliseconds exactly. Every associated symptom is supplied as its exact HKCategorySample UUID, start/end, type, severity, and complete HKSourceRevision fields. Symptom UUIDs are unique; distinct samples with the same symptom type remain distinct and are admitted. Missing, non-uniform, duplicate-UUID, resampled, or inconsistent evidence fails closed; the adapter performs no HealthKit query.
